subject: Speaker slot triage & demo decision for Dec 7 webinar
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Anna Park <anna.park@finlytics.com>
Cc: sponsors@cloudpulse.io
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Speaker slot triage & demo decision for Dec 7 webinar

Team + Anna —

Short one: Finlytics is signed as the guest speaker for our Dec 7 webinar (60m). We need a quick decision today on whether Anna will run the customer demo live or whether we hand the demo to an internal SME (Vanessa) and have Anna present a short customer story instead.

Constraints and considerations:
- Sponsor (CloudPulse) prefers a customer live-demo but will accept an internal walk-through if timing/latency risk is too high.
- Anna has asked for a 15–20 minute demo window and a 30-minute Q&A block.
- AV: we need a rehearsal slot at least 48 hours before, and a separate mic/test window for the demo env.
- Security: Anna requested a temporary sandbox token for the demo environment — ask Security/Platform for a time-limited credential if we go live.

Attachments: speaker_bios.pdf, demo_asset_list.xlsx (see drive folder in links)

Ask: please reply with your recommended path A (guest live demo) or path B (internal demo + guest story), and call out any blockers. If path A, confirm who owns sandbox provisioning and rehearsal scheduling.

Thanks —
Karthik
Head of Field Events
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Anna Park <anna.park@finlytics.com>

> Team + Anna —
> 
> Short one: Finlytics is signed as the guest speaker for our Dec 7 webinar (60m). We need a quick decision today on whether Anna will run the customer demo live or whether we hand the demo to an internal SME (Vanessa) and have Anna present a short customer story instead.

Path A is preferred from a storytelling perspective. Anna has strong product chops and the live demo will land well for attendees. Two operational notes:
- Vanessa can be the fallback for the demo (in-case of connectivity or sandbox issues).
- I can own scheduling the rehearsal windows and will book the 90-min greenroom block on Dec 6 PST (1st 30 min for slides/run, second 30 min for demo dry run, last 30 for contingency).

I attached speaker_bios.pdf and demo_asset_list.xlsx — Anna, can you confirm the demo script in the asset list aligns with your plan? If you need any changes please highlight directly in the sheet.

—Marissa

Quick operational add: if we go with Path A (guest live demo) we need to lock the following for AV/ops — attaching AV-checklist.pdf
- Rehearsal: Dec 6, 10:00–11:30 PT (Marissa to book)
- Demo test window: Dec 3 or Dec 4, 09:00–10:00 PT (platform team to provision sandbox + token)
- Backup plan: internal demo of same scenario pre-recorded and accessible via fallback link during the webinar (Vanessa owns recording)

Vanessa: can you confirm you can record a 12-minute internal demo by Nov 30 and that you have a clean token-free script (so we can replay without a live backend if needed)?

—Lauren

Hi team — thanks for the clear notes. I can do a live demo if we can get a sandbox token that is limited to demo data only. My Product Ops lead (productops@finlytics.com) will need access the week of Nov 29 to prep.

If token provisioning is a blocker, I am happy to pivot: I can present a 7–10 minute customer narrative + we can show a prerecorded 10–12 minute demo clip. Either way I will prepare the slide pack and a 2-minute intro to set context.

Attached: final_slide_deck_v01.pptx (note: still drafting)

—Anna Park

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>

Thanks everyone — consolidating final plan (decision: Path A with fallback):

Decisions
- Path A (guest live demo) is the primary plan. Anna will run live demo (15–20m).
- Fallback: Vanessa records an internal demo clip (12m) by Nov 30 and we host the recording in case of live-demo failure.

Owners / Action items
- Marissa: book greenroom rehearsal on Dec 6 10:00–11:30 PT and send calendar invites to all (DONE: invite pending acceptance).
- Platform/Security: provision sandbox token for anna.park@finlytics.com and productops@finlytics.com for Nov 29–Dec 7, time-limited and IP-restricted. (LAUNCH: please coordinate with infra — hubspot ref ENG-2026-FIN-78)
- Vanessa: produce 12-min recorded fallback demo by Nov 30 and upload to the shared Drive folder.
- Lauren: coordinate AV checklist and confirm backup playback link and streamer readiness.
- Anna: finalize slide deck and demo script in demo_asset_list.xlsx; confirm sandbox access request has been submitted.

Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDEF-sample — please drop final materials there. HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/record/ENG-2026-FIN-78

Attachments in thread: speaker_bios.pdf, demo_asset_list.xlsx, AV-checklist.pdf

If no major blockers by EOD Nov 26 PT we'll lock the run-of-show and publish the public registration page.

—Karthik
